name: Memento Mei
source:
An amnesiac spirit asks for your help. Wait, where is your friend?

A point-and-click horror visual novel where you try to help a ghost return it's memories. But why does it remind you of the friend you've been searching for? And what is this flesh-y sound coming from downstairs?

[from [url=https://miracle-koyka.itch.io/memento-mei]itch.io[/url]]
